name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 13 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2026-05-01, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.63 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
